messages.text: Heads up all, I'm out Jul 27 through Aug 7. Need someone to cover my book. James Anderson is the RM of record on a couple of the accounts I'd normally flag, so want to make sure the handoff is clean.
I can take primary coverage for the first week. I'm out Aug 3 though, so we need a second name for the back half.
I'll take the back half. I'm in the office the whole stretch. David, can you put coverage notes in ClientHub so we're not chasing you by text?
Yep, will log everything in ClientHub under each client's notes tab by Friday. Also tagging the open items so they show up in your task queue.
Quick question on {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0185}}. Low risk profile, brokerage only. Any scheduled rebalance or cash needs while David is away?
Nothing scheduled on {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00383}}. Client likes a quarterly check-in call, last one was in June so should be quiet. If they call, preferred contact is phone: {{CLIENT_PHONE:c_0185}}
Does anyone know if PortfolioMgr is still set to auto-flag drift over 5% or did that get changed after the spring update? Want to be sure we catch things while people are out.
I believe it's still 5% for low and medium risk, 3% for the conservative income models. I'll double check the config screen and confirm.

{{CLIENT_NAME:c_0073}} is the one I'm more careful about. Medium risk, and has both {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00155}} brokerage and {{ACCOUNT_NUMBER:a_00156}} cash management. They sometimes move money between the two on short notice.
Got it. Any pending transfers or outstanding requests I should know about before you go?

One possible. They mentioned wanting to pull some cash for a home project in August, nothing confirmed. If it comes up, verify identity per the callback procedure before anything moves out of the cash account.
Of course, standard callback to the number on file, no instructions accepted by email alone. I'll make sure Janet has that in the notes too.
Confirmed, drift threshold is still 5% for those models. Conservative income is 3%. No changes from the spring update.
Should we send a coverage heads-up to clients, or only if they reach out? Last time some got confused when the voicemail greeting changed.
I'd email the two of them a short note with Jamie and your names as backup. For {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0073}} I can use the address in ClientHub: {{CLIENT_EMAIL:c_0073}}. Will send tomorrow morning.
Sounds good. Please cc James Anderson as well so the client associate side has visibility. Same note for {{CLIENT_NAME:c_0185}} at {{CLIENT_EMAIL:c_0185}}.
Will do. I'll drop a coverage summary in here Friday once the ClientHub notes are in. Thanks both, appreciate it.
